tool.name: x402-doctor (prototype)
tool.license: NONE — the repository publishes no licence file and package.json declares none

dependency_lock.install: npm ci — the lockfile is reproduced exactly, or the install fails; no range is resolved at run time
dependency_lock.verified: after the install the tree is walked and compared against the lockfile in both directions — every locked package present at the locked version, and every installed package named by the lockfile. A mismatch aborts the run rather than producing a results file that reports pins it did not execute.

partial_evaluation.per_fixture: every result carries the complete held-back list under its own partial_evaluation.rules_held_back, each entry naming the rule, its status (`reported-by-tool` or `held-back`) and the corpus dimensions it would have decided; tool_detail.not_evaluated carries the same set with the prototype’s own level and message
partial_evaluation.unsupported_versions: the prototype is v2-only by construction; it reports v1-only challenges as failures rather than declining them, and the corpus records that as a scope difference rather than harmonising it
partial_evaluation.note: a dimension whose rules all ran is a verdict; a dimension whose deciding rule was held back is `not-evaluated`, never a pass

harness.transport: the recorded response is re-served from 127.0.0.1 and the fixture’s own origin is mapped onto it
harness.payments: no paidProbe is passed; a settlement is structurally impossible
harness.network: the git clone and one npm install; every other host is refused at the fetch boundary
